limits: 60 Hz desktop emulator results are not proof of 90 FPS on a PICO headset.
Each timed A/B window is 6-7 seconds, not a long thermal or full playthrough benchmark.
Low-detail shadow proxies follow vehicles, not individual animated wheel spokes.
Original cliff surfaces remain coarse at extreme close viewing distances.
Multi-state day/dusk/night direct-light bakes, console hierarchy and contextual instructional captions are subsequent stages.
